title: Event Ledger — draft 0.1.0
description: Append-only record of adoption and effect events (piece 4 of the NGA unified-architecture growth layer). An event carries the three-layer business identity (NGA overall-design §7.2), the accountability triple (festival D31), the P5 five-dimension version binding, and the correlation keys the replay matcher (piece 6) consumes: operation_id, payload digest, dependency versions, and the recorded arbitration order. The adopt state machine (piece 2) is the single writer; replay (piece 6) is a reader; nothing else writes. Record-family inputs (model outputs, tool responses, guard consumption) are NOT stored here — piece 6 fixtures supply them (S1 fork ruling, impl-2026-10-31/00-priors). Provenance: fields trace to NGA overall-design §7.2 / P5, 12-replay-and-audit-contract §2-§3, 15-graph-loop §B4 — all 'proposed' status in NGA, so every field here is an evidence-track probe answer, not an NGA commitment.

event_type.description: adoption = the control gate committed a decision; effect = an external operation was dispatched or its outcome recorded. Four operation types (inspect/replay/reevaluate/recover, NGA 12 §1) enter as structured callers of the state machine, not as event types.

arbitration_seq.description: Monotonic per-ledger sequence recording which concurrent competitor won (12 §2 'recorded arbitration order'). Replay re-uses the recorded order, never re-arbitrates.

grants_at_decision.description: Grant set pinned at the decision point (adoption events only). It rides the event because the event file is the adopt machine's only durable state — without it, a crash would make the 14-A4 dispatch-time revocation check vacuous.

outcome.description: The event's verdict. A 'conflict' outcome records a lost race, not an error. An 'unresolved' state on the effect path records dispatch-with-unknown-outcome (14-A5 counterexample three).

detail.description: Free-text provenance for the human reader; not a machine-checked field.

accountability.description: Festival D31 accountability triple — orthogonal to the business identity; both ride the same event (their join point).

identity.description: Three-layer business identity (NGA §7.2). Retries/recovery reuse operation_id; a new evaluation under new versions is a new evaluation_revision linked to the same business_request_id.

versions.description: P5 five-dimension version binding. A model version name is an address, not a substitute for the actual output — outputs live in piece-6 record-family fixtures. Evidence is included from day one (P5 names it first).

idempotency.description: The replay matcher's key: operation identity + payload digest + dependency versions (12 §3 step 4). Same key + same digest = reuse; same key + different digest = reject (15 §B4, 14-A5 counterexample four).

payload_digest.description: sha256 hex of JCS(request payload) — same shape and stack as the base's ContractHash.

grant.description: One entry of a grant set. Shape is shared with the adoption contract schema (each schema stays self-contained, frozen-engine stake C5-a); the two copies are kept in lockstep by a direct subtree diff in ledger.py plus the fixture suites on both sides.
